title: Warm Spicy Thai Chicken Noodles
description: A sour and spicy Thai dish featuring chicken and mascarpone, made in an iron teppan, this recipe is kid friendly and ayurvedic sattvic friendly, it is a twist on traditional Thai Isaan cuisine.
instructions: Heat the iron teppan over medium high heat and add the vegetable oil.
Add the chicken to the teppan and cook until browned and cooked through.
Remove the chicken from the teppan and set aside.
Add the Thai red curry paste to the teppan and cook for 1 minute.
Add the fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar to the teppan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the teppan and stir to combine with the curry sauce.
Add the mascarpone cheese to the teppan and stir until melted and well combined.
Return the chicken to the teppan and stir to combine with the noodles and sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the Warm Spicy Thai Chicken Noodles hot.
